prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-81689 from Larchmont Legal
prose.body:
Hi Fallowfield Games team,

Hope you’re having a great week! This is just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-81689 for services rendered. The total amount due is 8931.34 USDC.

We noticed the payment hasn’t landed in our system yet. To keep things on track, please send the funds to our standard vendor wallet: 0xc2f168d758338063f43e38ceaff2183a4346d275.

If you’ve already sent this, please disregard this note or let us know the transaction hash so we can match it on our end. We appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,
The Larchmont Legal Team
